care_education_placement.note: Care/placement allowances anywhere, plus contractor, agency or voluntary-sector narratives under a social care, SEND or education Service (placements, packages, early-years and SEN provider payments).

general_procurement.note: Everything else, e.g. Environment contractors, Transport Hire (incl. SEND home-to-school transport), IT, professional fees, minor works.

tiers.mixed_handling: rules disagree on whether the boundary value sits in the upper tier; clustering band is closed [0.9T, T]; split test uses payments < T and total >= T
